How I think

Heart. Mind. Soul.
One connected story.

I start with what matters to people.
Then give the idea a plan—and help the team bring it to life.

01 / Heart

Understand the people.

Listen to what people need, how they choose and the moments that matter. Find a reason for the brand to belong.

02 / Mind

Make a clear plan.

Turn that insight into a brief. Connect the brand goal, channels, budget and measures of success.

03 / Soul

Keep the brand feeling connected.

Help the team carry one idea across content, experiences and purchase. Learn from the response and improve the next plan.

Platform strategy / TikTok

From first impression
to active participation.

A brand story needs the right way in. At TikTok, I help brands and agencies connect opening-screen attention with creator participation. The projects below show how that thinking carries into launches, experiences and commerce.

01 / Awareness

TopView

Make the opening moment count.

The first video people see when they open TikTok. A full-screen format gives launches and brand stories an immediate moment of attention.

My contribution: advise on hooks, product storytelling, CTAs and destination readiness.

02 / Engagement & brand affinity

Branded Mission & Effect

Give people a reason to join.

Branded Mission invites creator content and amplifies selected videos as ads. Branded Effects turn the idea into an interactive experience people can use in their own stories.

My contribution: advise on the brief, mechanics, design, user journey and execution.
